articles.title: AI Things, Bits and Bites
articles.content:
各位好，

**AI动态快讯**是我正在尝试的一种新的AI新闻快报形式，旨在快速了解AI领域的最新动态。目前尚未确定这种快报的发布频率，但它们将采用简短的新闻摘要格式，方便您浏览、扫描和快速吸收信息。[编注：这些短篇文章将于东部时间上午9:00左右发布。]

那么，AI领域最近有什么动态？以下是本周及过去几天我关注的几则新闻。

**亚马逊旗下无人驾驶出租车Zoox首次开放付费服务**
Zoox于今年8月启动了首个美国付费服务市场，首站选择了拉斯维加斯，随后将扩展至旧金山等其他城市。作为一个充斥着自动驾驶出租车竞争的市场，即使优步再次投资自动驾驶领域，拉斯维加斯依然成为各家争夺的焦点。Zoox曾被许多消费者遗忘，但如今首次开放了付费乘坐服务，于本周一（8月10日）在拉斯维加斯正式上线。尽管特斯拉依靠摄像头的自动驾驶出租车表现令人失望，但谷歌Waymo依然稳居美国领先地位。Zoox的车内没有方向盘，提供了更大的空间，座椅采用类似公共交通的马车式排列。

**英伟达豪言AI工厂计算成为可投资资产**
英伟达近日提出了一个令人震惊的声明，称AI工厂计算正在成为一种可投资的资产。这项计划的规模高达5000亿美元，其中英伟达将承诺提供1250亿美元，占潜在交易的25%。参与的金融合作伙伴包括Apollo Global Management、黑石集团、黑岩（通过全球基础设施合伙人）、布鲁克菲尔德资产管理公司、高盛和凯雷集团等。英伟达此前曾因一些创意型的循环融资和供应商融资而备受争议，这被认为是其参与美国国家防御AI基础设施项目的一部分，该项目需要大量的计算资源。随着数据中心规模扩大至吉瓦级，HBM内存芯片和其他瓶颈使得计算成本大幅上升，从而推动超大规模企业资本支出进一步增加。目前，数据中心越来越多地通过债务融资，包括表外的保证金债务。

**扎克伯格发表类似OpenAI或Anthropic的“文章”**
Meta CEO马克·扎克伯格发表了一篇题为《未来属于所有人》的文章，内容类似于OpenAI或Anthropic的风格，并突然声称Meta不再是Metaverse公司，而是一家开源AI研究机构。与此同时，Meta推出了Muse Glimmer，这是一个新颖的模型，似乎是其迷惘且不断变化的AI战略的又一次转向。

**Muse Glimmer与阿里巴巴Qwen3.6-27B竞争，采用开源许可**
Muse Glimmer在表现上与阿里巴巴的Qwen3.6-27B模型相当，并且提供了无附加条件的开源许可。至少Meta终于执行了一个前沿模型，某种程度上来说，这已经是一段时间以来的进展了。
articles.summary:
Hey Everyone,

AI Things, Bits and Bites is a new AI news orientated feature I’m experimenting with to quickly catch up with what’s going on in AI. I’m not sure of the cadence of this feature article type yet, but they will follow a shorter newsy format that you can browse, scan and absorb easily. Or, at least that’s the plan. [Edit: these shorter articles would appear around 9:00 AM Eastern time.]

So what’s going on in AI? These are some of the stories I’m watching this week and over the past few days.

Amazon Robotaxi Zoox Enters AV Race

Amazon’s robotaxi Zoox has launched its first paid service in U.S. this August. Las Vegas is first. San Francisco and other markets should follow. It’s Sin City to the max, with more robotaxi competitors entering the fray even as Uber is investing again in autonomous vehicles. A lot of consumers totally forgot about Zoox. Paid rides on Zoox became available for the first time ever, with services that launched in Las Vegas this Monday (Aug. 10). Tesla robotaxis that only use cameras have been a huge disappointment. While Waymo is the outright leader in the U.S. There’s no steering wheel here so more room. The seating feels like public transport with these weird carriage-style seating arrangements.

Autonomous Driving Fleets by Vehicles

Nvidia Organizes Financing Consortium with Wall Street for AI Infra

When you are financing Neo Clouds, why not go all in? Nvidia makes a rather outrageous claim that AI factory compute is becoming an investable asset. It’s a $500 Billion third-party financing gig. Nvidia has cash to spare and will backstop up to $125 ​billion, or 25% of the potential deals. Financial partners include at least Apollo Global Management, Blackstone, BlackRock (via Global Infrastructure Partners), Brookfield Asset Management, Goldman Sachs, and KKR. Nvidia has been guilty of some creative circular and vendor financing deals in what we can only assume is a U.S. National defense AI infra mandated project where they think they need all of this compute. We are entering larger and larger gigawatt scale AI clusters of datacenters, even as HBM memory chips and other bottlenecks make said compute way more expensive pushing hyperscaler Capex higher for multiple reasons. Now Datacenters are increasingly being financed on debt including off-balance-sheet margin debt.

Meta Claims to be an Open-Source Good Guy

Mark Zuckerberg wrote an OpenAI or Anthropic-esque “essay” about the future of AI called The Future is for Everyone. While suddenly pretending that Meta isn’t a Metaverse company but a benevolent AI open-source lab. Meta released Muse Glimmer, a neat little model that appears to be yet another pivot in their rather baffling and constantly shifting AI strategy.

Muse Glimmer competes favorable with Alibaba Qwen3.6-27B and has a favorable no strings attached Open-source permission. So at least they finally executed on a frontier model, in a manner of speaking (it’s been a while).
